body:
Closes nothing; evidence delivery for #288 (Windows Native Error-Cone Runtime Verification). Do not merge before owner review; issue closure and merge are owner-gated.

## What this delivers

Runtime-verification evidence for the landed Windows WASAPI failure cone, the diagnostic writer swap (sites #8/#9/#10), carrier B (`DrainVerdict::Aborted` carrying `AbortReason`), and the diagnostics close protocol — executed on a real Windows 11 host (Realtek endpoint, WASAPI shared/event-driven, engine SRC every open) via cross-compiled x86_64-pc-windows-gnu test binaries.

- `evidence/windows-runtime-288/EXECUTION_DAGS.md` (R1): the four execution chains (failure cone, writer swap, carrier B, close protocol) reconstructed from source at fc81b68 with file:line nodes and classified causal edges (PO/SW/scheduling).
- `evidence/windows-runtime-288/SCENARIO_MATRIX.md` (R2): the frozen A1–A8 oracle/scenario matrix with 9 recorded design decisions.
- `evidence/windows-runtime-288/LEDGER.md`: executed verdicts bound to raw receipts; findings F1–F6; claim ceiling; executed-source provenance addendum; retained superseded receipts.
- `evidence/windows-runtime-288/raw/`: 50 unedited per-row logs, mutation hash bookkeeping, binary identity.

## Verdicts (each bound to raw receipts)

- **A1/A2** cone necessity + order: PASS with witnesses (relayed carrier B payload observed; M2 mutation pins the order oracle).
- **A3** production mutations M1 (delete-stop) / M2 (swap-order): both exact-RED at the designed bound, byte-restored (hash bookkeeping).
- **A4** writer-swap sink matrix: broken ≡ healthy on terminal class/exit across all three sites; the three pre-swap hazards (N-01 hang, F5 blocked wedge, #9/#10 Failed-instead-of-Stopped misattribution) reproduced as designed REDs; the #11-class residual keyed on blocked ∧ default hook ∧ `--nocapture`, eliminated by the DG-4b product posture; seam-arm matched pair (VF=1 vs VF=0) with an in-child `apply_calls` synchronization witness.
- **A5** N-01 four premises: confirmed pre-swap, eliminated post-swap.
- **A6** carrier B: pipeline PASS through the real cone/session/presentation (Device-class reason end-to-end with the real HRESULT); real-endpoint device-INITIATED row honestly BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT (non-elevated host).
- **A7** close protocol: diagnostics 16/16, integration subprocess oracles 2/2 + 2/2, headless 372/372, playback 207/207 — all on real Windows.
- **A8** E-7 tier-2: deferred with recorded inertness evidence.

## Production change

NONE. All source additions are cfg(test)/cfg(all(test, windows)) — witness printouts, child oracles, the volume-apply seam (design-named minimal injection, migration §7.3). In non-test builds `wasapi.rs` gains only the inlined `apply_stream_volume` wrapper whose body is the identical direct COM call it replaced.

## Review

Two independent reviews (concurrency/causal; oracle/evidence integrity): APPROVE_WITH_NOTES; all P2 findings closed in the review-round commit (seam counter + matched VF pair + provenance addendum + ledger corrections) and delta re-verified.

Gate: `lefthook run pre-push --all-files` green (commit-convention, vocabulary, plugin-boundary, fmt, clippy, workspace tests, release-policy, docs-verify).
